en: The image displays an old sepia-toned photograph of a wide, tree-lined street with elegant buildings on the left side. The street is relatively empty except for a horse-drawn carriage, a few pedestrians, and some early street lamps. The architecture is historic, with visible signs and ornate facades, typical of Central or Eastern European towns in the late 19th or early 20th century. The text at the top provides multiple names for the location: Zemun (Serbian), Semlin (German), and Zimony (Hungarian), along with 'Hauptgasse (Hotel Streicher),' suggesting this is a main street and a notable hotel.
